name: Nebius Group N.V.
why: Nebius files a 20-F once a year and its quarters on Form 6-K without XBRL (every 6-K in the submissions feed carries isXBRL=0), so companyfacts holds annual USD facts only. The quarters below are hand-keyed from the interim-report exhibits, as printed, and scripts/test-nbis-interims.mjs proves that scripts/lib/interim-parse.mjs reads the same figures from the fixtures under scripts/fixtures/nbis/. One row set per interim report, three a year, keyed by accession because two 6-Ks were filed on 2026-08-12 and 'EX-99.2' alone is ambiguous.
unit: USD millions as printed; the parser multiplies by 1,000,000
signConvention: as printed: outflows in parentheses are negative, proceeds positive, losses negative. The interim parser keeps the printed sign (its Enlivex test pins capex at -60,000), whereas a tagged Payments* fact is positive; the capex panel (blueprint 15.0) stores outflows positive and must flip these lines.
filerType: 20-F annual, 6-K interim (foreign private issuer, Netherlands N.V.; formerly Yandex N.V. to 2024-08-16)

taggedAnchors.note: the annual anchor for the 6-K quarters (blueprint 15.1); the 20-F/A of 2026-05-22 (0001104659-26-065681) did not replace the tagged financials in companyfacts as of 2026-09-11
the FY2025 convertible-note proceeds sit under this tag in the 20-F; the 6-K prints them as 'Proceeds from issuance of convertible notes'
convert principal at maturity at 2025-12-31 (the Note 12 total); the 6-K table below carries the same column at 2026-06-30
